root_cause: Inherited i18n Brain source-contract tests depend on exact pre-refactor variable names while the current transform uses file-scoped route-aware DOM injection. One pricing test incorrectly requires build outputs in the pre-build source.
fix: Replace brittle token assertions with actual isolated transformer executions and source-to-built pricing assertions, including repeatability and route-aware semantics.
security: No test removed; no mandatory workflow, migration, production or RLS change; all runtime assertions must pass.
prevention_rule: Release-contract tests of build transformers must run the actual transformer in fresh disposable fixture roots; avoid matching a fixed spelling for internal variable names, while asserting the original invariant and exact-head gates.
